content: Mukuze Nyakasane, igulu lyoshi liri lyâge

content.text: Yimbiri Nyakasane olwimbo luhyâhya, igulu lyoshi liyimbire Nyakasane
Yimbiri Nyakasane, mukuze izîno lyâge mukazimanyîsa bwaca bwayira oku kuciza aciza.
Irenge lyâge muliganîre omu karhî k’ab’emahanga, n’ebi ajizire by’okurhangâza mubimanyîse omu mashanja goshi.
Bulya Nyakasane arhali ntindi, anakwânîne aj’irenge, akwânîne ayôbohwe kulusha abandi ba nyamuzinda boshi.
Bulyâla banyamuzinda b’abapagani linali ibumba, Nyakasane yêhe ye wajiraga amalunga.
Obwâmi n’obumuleke bumushokolîre, n’entebe yâge buhashe n’obulangashane buyirikwo.
Mwe milala y’amashanja mweshi, hêrezi Nyakasane, hêrezi Nyakasane irenge n’obuhashe.
Hêrezi Nyakasane irenge ly’izîno lyâge. Mumurhûle enterekêro munahike omu côgo câge:
Muharâmye Nyakasane n’iyâmbala ly’ebujinji, mujugume embere zâge, mwe bihugo mweshi.
Muderhe omu karhî k’amashanja; mpu: «Nyakasane oyîmire!» Agwîsire igulu buzibu mpu lirhagihuligana; arhegeka n’amashanja burhalyâlyanya.
Amalunga gacîshinge, n’igulu lishembuke, enyanja ekunguze haguma n’ebimuli byoshi.
Amashwa gashagaluke haguma n’ebimuli byoshi, emirhi y’emuzirhu nayo esîme.
Omu masù ga Nyakasane, bulyâla ayishire, bulya ayîshitwîr’igulu olubanja; âtwira igulu olubanja n’obushinganyanya, ârhegeka n’amashaja burharhebana.
